scope: Concrete conditional battery certificate provider and outward SOC/capacity query using the frozen integer kernels.
quantifier: Every finite admitted prefix of a static certified episode, without a selected lifetime horizon.

known: Fixed R0 and three R/tau pairs
Represented current and actual interval scales
unknown: Static real capacity inside declared capacity cells
Static real initial SOC inside the declared interval
Initial RC voltages inside the declared common box
restrictions: No temperature dependence or parameter drift
Current constant during each represented interval
model.comparison_scope: A conditional submodel of the retained-history C reference, not the original full 16-quantity identification task.

observations.input: Signed integer microampere current, unsigned actual ticks, closed integer-nanovolt endpoint-voltage interval.
observations.hard_premise: For every observation, the supplied voltage interval contains the exact model terminal voltage for the actual admitted configuration.
observations.semantics: Deterministic bounded-error feasibility. Existing Gaussian sigma is not used as a hard bound, and no Gaussian likelihood or coverage equivalence is claimed.
observations.chronology: Caller supplies each actual observation once and in order. No source-delivery or missing-sample detection is implemented by this bank.
observations.truth_rule: Synthetic truth is available only to generation and scoring, never inference, configuration centering, initial guesses or state corrections.

integer_ranges.SOC_coordinates: Physical z,z0 are in [0,1]; x=Z*z and x0=Z*z0 are SOC-grid coordinates. Stored T_j, current preimage S and depletion R_j all use grid coordinates, so x0=x+P*Z/(K*Q).
integer_ranges.capacity_endpoints: Positive uint32 microAh; exact capacity may be real between endpoints.
integer_ranges.charge: int64 P in [-2^44,2^44], initially zero; exact signed current-code/tick integration.
integer_ranges.SOC_ratio: N=P*65536 has |N|<=2^60. Positive denominator126000000*Q_endpoint<2^59. Directed signed quotient/remainder division encloses N/(K*Q). Keep endpoints int64 until clipping.
integer_ranges.current: Configured positive limit<=200000 microA; every input lies within that signed limit.
integer_ranges.resistance: Integer R0/R_i in [0,1000] milliohm. Current times resistance is exact nanovolts; compute in int64.
integer_ranges.RC_domain: Each configured integer interval lies in [-B_i,B_i], B_i<=2^30. Configuration validates current_limit*R_i<=B_i.
integer_ranges.time_constant: Positive uint32 tau_ticks; actual uint32 ticks divided by tau_ticks supplies the frozen attenuation kernel.
integer_ranges.OCV_and_observation_voltage: Each endpoint within [-8000000000,8000000000]nV. OCV segment span times SOC_ONE<=16000000000*65536<2^50.
integer_ranges.corrected_voltage: Observation plus exact R0 drop plus three RC interval endpoints is far inside int64; magnitude<=8000000000+200000000+3*2^30.

representation.immutable_cell: Closed capacity interval crossed with the common initial-SOC interval and initial-RC box. Adjacent/overlapping cells retain their original meaning.
representation.admitted_capacity_domain: Union of the supplied closed cells. The generic API permits gaps; a query hull does not assert those gaps are covered or feasible. The experiment explicitly uses contiguous closed bins.
persistent_state: One outward initial-SOC interval per original cell
Pointer to immutable live backing configuration
representation.extension_from_002: Per-cell initial-SOC intervals add bounded retained evidence beyond the bare exclusion mask. They contract monotonically while the immutable capacity cells stay fixed.
representation.memory_rule: Count the complete backing configuration, state, caller-owned transaction workspace, input/output objects, source-owned stack and read-only data; identify external runtime/platform costs separately.

update.physical: Stage the complete bank. Integrate exact charge and propagate all three RC intervals using actual dt and exact I*R targets.
update.SOC_preimage: Scan all nondecreasing PWL segments. Positive-slope inverse endpoints are divided outward; an admitted flat segment contributes its entire SOC span. Include knot/end-point equalities. No segment means empty support.
update.per_cell: T_j_next=T_j intersect (S_current+R_j(P)), where R_j encloses SOC-grid depletion for the complete original capacity interval.
update.exclusion: Clear a cell bit only when this initial-SOC intersection is empty. Inactive cells never reappear. Their old stored endpoints are ignored.
update.compatible_set: F_n contains complete static configurations (z0,Q,initial_RC) compatible with all admitted observations and SOC-domain constraints through n. F_n is nested.
update.guarantee: For every configuration in F_n and every original cell containing it, that cell remains active and its retained interval contains x0=Z*z0.

query.SOC: Hull across active cells of (T_j-R_j(P)) intersect [0,SOC_ONE].
query.capacity: Hull of original capacity endpoints across active cells.
query.retention: Queries use persistent per-cell constraints only, without replacing an earlier target constraint by a latest-only constraint.
query.quiet_property: When P does not change, contraction of T_j and removal of cells cannot widen either target hull. RC state may still relax.
query.empty: Positive inconsistency with has_support=0; numerical bound fields are not estimates.
limits: Nonempty outer support need not imply exact feasibility
Intrabin and nuisance-state correlations can retain false positives

transaction.workspace: Caller-owned staged complete bank, with disjoint bank/configuration/input/workspace storage.
transaction.negative_status: Entire bank remains byte-identical; observation was not propagated. Workspace may change.
transaction.valid_contradiction: Commit advanced charge/RC state and empty evidence, return positive inconsistency.
transaction.initialization: Declared entering RC and SOC bounds must be sound; no truth-derived correction or implicit settled-state assumption.
transaction.trusted_execution: Conforming C99 exact-width arithmetic, initialized trusted objects, immutable live configuration, no concurrent mutation or hardware fault during the call.
transaction.recovery_and_drift: Not implemented. Resetting a mask, changing cell meanings or renewing error budgets is not an admitted recovery operation.

conditional_usefulness.capacity: Separated charge levels can exclude a capacity cell when their outward implied initial-SOC strips become disjoint. No universal elapsed-time bound is claimed.
conditional_usefulness.zero_charge_control: If P is zero at every observation and all cells share the same initial-SOC prior, every nonempty cell has identical SOC0 contraction; observations add no capacity discrimination and support stays at its initial declared union unless inconsistent.
conditional_usefulness.return_to_zero: After prior nonzero-charge evidence, returning to P=0 retains learned capacity exclusions; a zero final net charge does not erase the intervening information.
conditional_usefulness.RC_width: The inherited uniform-width lemma needs explicit active-update contraction and coefficient-span bounds. Nominal35Hz alone is insufficient.
conditional_usefulness.precision_thresholds: No new hard SOC/capacity accuracy threshold is introduced; report actual target widths, numerical status and truth scoring separately.

composed_availability_corollary.additional_domain_premise: All admitted actual capacities are at most100000microAh; actual initialSOC/RC lie in their declared domains, and a true compatible configuration exists at every prefix.
composed_availability_corollary.derived_charge_bound: |P_n|=K*Q*|z0-z_n|<=12600000000000<2^44 because z0,z_n are in[0,1]. The range follows from the static model/domain, not an elapsed-time limit.
composed_availability_corollary.conclusion: Under admitted observations/input ranges and trusted execution/chronology, every push returns OK, the bank remains valid, and every true-containing cell survives for every finite prefix. Age alone cannot cause a range error or committed inconsistency.
composed_availability_corollary.limits: Conditional availability/containment/retention for this restricted provider; useful width and physical validity of the model/error assumptions remain separate.

remaining: Empirically justified acquisition/model error bounds or simultaneous probabilistic coverage
Unknown R/tau/R0, hysteresis, OCV uncertainty and temperature dependence
Tighter preservation of intrabin correlations or a proved cell-refinement/transport operation
Source chronology verification, persistence, recovery, aging and parameter drift
Complete application/target runtime memory, cycles and power qualification
Physical-cell validation and the original full-estimator indefinite-runtime goal
